head: codex/83-html-observatory-readiness
title: [v0.92][WP-18A-HTML] Complete the HTML Observatory Runtime v3 client
body:
Closes #83

## Summary
- integrate the HTML Observatory with the live Runtime v3 roster, qualified capture time, and authenticated Layer 8 chat
- use one JCS-canonical signed ACIP identity-message contract for Layer 8 and agent-to-agent communication
- enforce durable request and acknowledgement replay continuity across restart without browser-held private keys
- return attempt-local canonical-ingress reservation truth and prove concurrent carriers cannot claim another submission's watermark
- publish #83 independently; legacy #5836 consumes this result but does not gate it

## Validation
- runtime-kernel library: 47 passed
- exact acknowledgement restart continuity: 1 passed
- production binary ACIP WSS: 1 passed
- strict Clippy for library and binaries: passed
- exact managed-Chrome trusted-public-TLS proof: 22/22 passed
- typed issue validation generation 70: passed
- independent exact-head review: passed with both final findings fixed
